name: io.github.hyperdrift-io/standup
description: Read-only: who is waiting on you across your public GitHub projects, what to start with, how long it takes.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Any read-only GitHub token; without it the server falls back to gh auth token.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini API key. Leave unset to use Vertex AI (GOOGLE_SA_KEY_B64 + VERTEX_PROJECT) or Amazon Bedrock with your AWS credentials.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SA_KEY_B64
environmentVariables.description: Base64 service-account JSON for Vertex AI.

environmentVariables.name: VERTEX_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Google Cloud project for Vertex AI.

environmentVariables.name: STANDUP_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the previous brief per handle (default ~/.standup).
